notes.title: Trick or Tapple!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to the "Trick or Tapple" Event![/h1]

Halloween has arrived in the world of Tapple, bringing mysterious and [color=#FF4500]Spooky[/color] Tapples for you to discover and collect. During this event, you’ll have the chance to encounter unique Tapples, each designed to give you a "treat" or a "trick."

• Collect new [color=#FF4500]Spooky[/color] Tapples with exclusive Halloween designs.
• Compete with friends to see who can collect the most [color=#FF4500]Spooky[/color] Tapples by the end of the event!

Don’t miss out on these limited-time [color=#FF4500]Spooky[/color] Tapples! The event runs until November 7. Will you get a "trick" or a "treat"? Join in and find out!

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: It’s Spooky Around Tapple Town!
notes.content: Get ready for a hauntingly fun time in Tapple Town! Throughout October, keep an eye out for our new Spooky Tapples, featuring unique Halloween designs! Play, collect, and enjoy these seasonal Tapples before they disappear after Halloween! Stay tuned for more drops as new Spooky Tapples will be added every week!

notes.title: Tapple Twos-Day Returns with Giggly Green Tapple!
notes.content: I’ve replaced the GG Honey Tapple with the new Giggly Green Tapple! Tapple Twos-Day begins again this Tuesday, with double drops and a higher chance to collect the Giggly Green Tapple. Please be patient as I make major improvements to Tapple - Idle Clicker. My goal is to provide long-term enjoyment to all players and improve the game with every update. This update is just the beginning; more exciting changes are on the way!

notes.title: Tapple Twos-Day
notes.content:
[b] 🎉 Double the Drops for Tapple Twos-Day! 🎉[/b]

notes.title: Crafting BETA 2.0 & Drop Pool Changes
notes.content:
I'm thrilled to announce the addition of [b]27 new Honey Tapples[/b] in Tapple Town! These tapples bring a fresh twist to the game and can be acquired through crafting or exchanging.

[b]🔹 Crafting & Exchange:[/b]
• [b]Exchange two Colored Honey Tapples[/b] to receive a [b]Gilded Honey Tapple[/b].
• Dive into our new [b]Crafting BETA 2.0[/b]! Use the seeds you’ve been saving to open Honey Chests and discover special rewards.
• The crafting system is not fully optimized yet but I know you gamers have been requesting it! I will continue to make updates to the UI & code to provide a better experience.

[b]🔹 Drop Pool Update:[/b]
• The drop pool now features only [b]two items[/b]: the [b]Base Tapple[/b] and the [b]GG Honey Tapple[/b] at a VERY LOW %.

[b]🔹 Developer Note:[/b]
• I plan to continue adding more features to Tapple - Idle Clicker to make it much more than just a "clicker" game, special thanks to everyone who is playing daily! I love seeing screenshots uploaded to the Steam Community/Discord and hope Tapple continues growing with your help!

Navigate through Tapple with ease using new and improved UI elements.

notes.title: Updated Skin Collection & Added Items!
notes.content:
What's Goodie Gamers!

I am excited to announce an update to our skin collection and the introduction of a brand new drop pool for seeds!

[b]Here’s what’s new:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Updated Skin Collection:[/b] Check out the latest additions to the skin collection. I’ve added the newest drop pool along with others!
[*][b]New Seed Drop Pool:[/b] Seeds can now be earned while playing. Here’s how it works:
[list]
[*]Earn 1 seed for every 30 minutes of playtime.
[*]A maximum of 3 seeds can be earned per day.
[*]Seeds are currently considered skins and I am working on implementing them into a new farming skill. No promises, but I'm trying my best to make Tapple unlike all the other clicker games. I will continue to improve upon the gameplay and existing features along with implementing new ideas, but I don't want to rush into anything and have it all go to 💩.
[/list]
[/list]

I want to extend my gratitude to everyone who has been playing Tapple. Seriously, your support and feedback have been the greatest. Consider spreading the word about Tapple by sharing it with your friends and don't hesitate to join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/PyMCmErk]Discord[/url].

Happy Tapping!

notes.title: New Update: Canvas Legends Set & More!
notes.content:
[h3]Game Update Notes[/h3]

[h2]New Additions and Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]New Drops:[/b] 20 new drops have been added.
[*][b]Removed Drops:[/b] The old drop pool has been removed.
[*][b]Item Name Colors:[/b] Item name colors now resemble the set they belong to.
[*][b]Rarity Adjustments:[/b]
[*][b]Newton's Tapple:[/b] Changed to Uncommon.
[*][b]Green Tapple:[/b] Changed to Uncommon.
[*][b]Basic Tapple:[/b] The only true Common drop currently. Future Common items will remain in the drop pool forever.
[/list]

[h2]Important Information:[/h2]

[list]
[*]The recent changes did not affect the drop rate, but going forward, Common items will be those that stay in the drop pool permanently.
[*]I am working on game updates day in and day out. If you experienced issues with the last update, it’s due to the change in code.
[/list]

[h2]Issue Resolution:[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]To avoid any issues with breaking the game, please follow these steps:[/b]
[*]Hold the backspace key.
[*]Reset the game to 0.
[*]Close Tapple.
[*]Relaunch Tapple.
[*]This method has been reported to work based on user feedback and has been tested during playtesting.
[/list]

[h2]Thanks for Playing! Seriously[/h2]

[list]
[*]I apologize for any confusion caused by the lack of prior information. Thank you for your understanding.
[*]Enjoy the new [b]Canvas Legends[/b] set!
[/list]

notes.title: Tapple Thanks You
notes.content:
I’m excited to share a new patch for Tapple, bringing some significant improvements! In this update, I’ve focused on fixing the level system and addressing issues with the secret button.

As a solo developer working on my first game ever, I’ve been working hard to make sure these fixes improve the overall experience for everyone. Besides these major updates, I’ve also made several minor adjustments to enhance the gameplay.

When I started developing Tapple, I never expected to have so many wonderful people playing it. Your support has been incredibly helpful and motivating. A special thank you goes to the amazing play testers. Your feedback and thorough testing have helped me tackle and fix most of the issues/bugs quickly and efficiently.

Keep an eye out for more updates as I continue to improve Tapple. Thank you for your support, and happy tapping!

-Zeeno
